About

The Artist
Behind the Pencil

Hello! I'm Abinaya K, a passionate pencil portrait artist based in Tiruchengode, Tamil Nadu. Under the name Scoo Bee Art, I bring faces, emotions, and moments to life through the gentle dance of graphite on paper.

My journey with art began as a quiet obsession — filling sketchbooks with faces, studying how light sculpts a cheekbone, how a single eyebrow raises tell a whole story. Over the years, that obsession became a craft, and that craft became a calling.

I specialise in hyper-realistic pencil portraits, family group sketches, old photo restorations, and merge compositions. Every portrait I create is a labour of love — hand-drawn with meticulous attention to detail, shading, and likeness.

"Art is not what you see, but what you make others see."
— Abinaya K
